blocks.text: Langley houses by price band, September 2026

64 houses sold in September against 449 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,250,001 to $1,500,000, with 20 sold (31% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $900,001 to $1,000,000 at 24%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Langley houses by bedroom count, September 2026
Splitting September 2026 by size, the most sales came from the 3 to 4 bedrooms group, with 37 of 64 sold, against 173 of 449 listed.
